name: trackiq-amazon-excess-inventory
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Excess and Aged Inventory Plan
summary: Finds the Amazon inventory sitting too long — products with cover far beyond target, stock stranded on SKUs that no longer sell, and unfulfillable units — and ranks them by capital tied up, with a recommendation per product to discount, advertise, bundle, remove or write off.

delivery.note: in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.
